name: Unbelievers
overview: Scripture reveals that unbelievers are characterized by a rejection of God, resulting in spiritual corruption and alienation from the life of God due to ignorance and hardness of heart. They face condemnation because they do not believe in Jesus Christ, the only begotten Son of God, and their sin leads to death rather than eternal life. Believers are warned to guard against an evil heart of unbelief that causes departure from God, emphasizing the serious consequences of unbelief and the need for faith in Christ.
